title: Panel vote
description: Plan 04b: one seat of a blocker panel's vote on one raw blocker. `block` means stop the work until the owner decides and must propose two or three options for the owner; `downgrade` means it is an ordinary blocking finding for the next worker attempt. Every vote carries a reason.

blockerId.description: The raw blocker message id this vote is about

seat.description: This seat's number (1..N, one per reviewer)

options.description: block only: the two or three options the owner chooses from
